notes.title: v 1.0.0.6 Major Update
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.6 Major Update
=====
(It's a large download, because there's a lot of new stuff...!)

- The dialogue for the entire game now highlights important information with coloured text, making it MUCH easier to parse even if you are using Instant Text/skipping the text
- Reworked the Hallucination trait: now its effects are much clearer, and it also affects Tactical Diplomacy with its own Hallucinations card
- Added global Steam Leaderboards functionality: completing cases now gives you a Fame score depending on how well you did, multiplied by the Difficulty level
- There's now a dedicated Credits screen after the game ends. If you streamed the game on Twitch or uploaded a Youtube video and would like to mentioned, get in touch with me to be added to future updates!
- If you win consecutive Tactical Diplomacy attempts, they start to have more modifiers that change the rules in different ways
- New icons for documents/books/loot that are clearer than before
- Two additional ways to get the Gambler to cooperate without playing the dice game. Arm Wrestling for Physique characters, and a riddle+question for Intelligence characters.
- The Hunting Rifle and Hammer have both been buffed significantly
- 10 new Perks: the dream event has now been moved to a Perk, making it optional during a run
- Various other smaller bug fixes/balance changes

notes.title: v 1.0.0.5 Patch
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.5 Patch
=====
- New Pet available from the trader: a Falcon! You can now choose a pet birb instead of a cat/doggo.
- You can now use Tactical Diplomacy to bluff suspects at 3 stars to force an admission: this means you can now (theoretically) complete a case without completing all the side-quests!
- Dogma cards now do not need an additional card discard to be banished
- Discarding a card for a Charge now costs 1 second
- All suspects now have unique conversation text if you confront them about their motive
- Added some additional variety to many other conversations
- Fixed infinite card draw exploit

notes.title: v 1.0.0.4 Hotfix
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.4 Hotfix
=====
- You can now hold TAB in exploration/dialogue to review your existing perks/skills
- Steamworks screenshot functionality has been restored
- Deep Breath cards now cost 0 seconds to play

notes.title: v 1.0.0.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.3 Hotfix
=====
- Expanded Options menu for additional Audio/Video/Gameplay options
- Added Instant Text and Slower Combat options in the menu
- Adjusted Magister-General to be friendlier
- Reminders for Leaving/Poison/Burning no longer reappear after you leave the game

notes.title: v 1.0.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.2 Hotfix
=====
- Rebalanced combat: 
	- Some enemy stats adjusted to be more fair (especially those with excessive Armor)
	- 'Weak Block' & 'Weak Attacks' now cost 0 seconds to play
	- 'Sing Song' is now banished instead of being deleted
	- Pet and companion max HP adjusted slightly higher
	- Inquisitor's Chain Lightning has been buffed.
- Rebalanced Tactical Diplomacy: 
	- 'Annoying' cards now have a 1 in 3 chance to draw 1 if deleted
	- 'Long Talk' also draws a card after its effect is resolved
	- 'Tell a Joke' generates 2 Empathy instead of 1
- Companions now cost 1 less Crown to hire per day: Sage/Spy reduced to 1 crown, and Mercenary is now free!
- Fixed some minor misc bugs and spelling mistakes

notes.title: v 1.0.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
v 1.0.0.1 Hotfix
=====
- Fixed a few rare crash bugs during combat.
- Loot bags will no longer give zero loot: instead, they have a small chance to give loot worth 2 Trinkets instead of 1.
- Combat slowed down slightly: enemies will now pause for an extra second before ending their turn.
- Adjusted enemy combat damage to be easier at lower levels
- Fixed a bug where the Trader's traits were not showing properly when observed carefully.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED – THE MAGISTER IS LAUNCHING SOON!
notes.notes:
We have a release date! The Magister will launch September 2nd on Steam (and Nintendo Switch, and also for Xbox One on Sept 3rd)! If you haven't already, be sure to add it your wishlist and you'll be alerted the moment it's available.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
Before the full game launches, we're also going to be releasing The Magister: The First Two Days to give you a chance to sample the action and start your investigation early. As the name suggests, it will include the first two days of the randomly-generated whodunnit adventure (the full game takes place over 14 days). We'll provide an update when it's available, but rest assured that it will be available to download from Steam for free sometime before September 2nd.
